# Two Poems in December 30.1

![](https://www.robertpeake.com/files/2019/05/december.png)

I received my contributor’s copy of December 30.1 (Spring/Summer 2019) today. The new editors have done a smashing job of carrying on its literary legacy, and I’m delighted to have work within its pages.

You can catch order issue 30.1 or subscribe [on the December website.](https://decembermag.org/)
